title: 撰写了文件勤勉控制权变更001
domain: 计算机与信息系统经理
role: 计算机与信息系统经理
instruction:
您是 Wilhelmina Arriaga，她是 Stellwyn Advisory Group 投资委员会对其拟议收购 Cranmere Surveying 的审查中为 Hester Kilbride 提供支持的技术尽职调查负责人。 Greyhaven Freight 和彭布罗克委员会也参与了更广泛的投资组合讨论，因此请保持指定交易和受众的明确性。数据室包含大约600杂乱的文件，包括许可证登记册、供应商技术尽职报告、三年的承包商发票和克兰米尔的风险日志，但没有提供索引或商定的买方视图。一个容易被忽略的发票附件似乎涉及不可转让的调查处理许可证，该许可证可能会终止或需要同意控制权变更；委员会更有可能注意到更大、更清晰的调查结果，但这些调查结果可能不会改变其投票。 Viktor Delacroix、Noor Dalgaard、Idris Wolstenholme 和 Felix Escamilla 将与财务、法律、运营、安全和交易团队一起使用这些材料。准备一个名为`stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf`的PDF并将其放置在工作目录的顶层。它必须包含一页的 IT 尽职调查摘要以及集成条件，然后是 4 9 月投资委员会的三张演示式幻灯片。
就是否继续、仅在有条件的情况下继续或不继续提出明确的建议，并将该建议作为最终决定而不是未来步骤的清单。在依赖“日1”这个术语之前先定义它，因为有些读者将其用于合法完成，而另一些读者则将其用于完成后的第一个操作日；区分过渡状态和最终状态技术模型。不要假装数据室证明了它无法证明的事实，不要发明购买价格、储蓄、事件、许可证、人数或概率数字，并清楚地标记假设、未知数、依赖性、所有者、时间安排和升级点。将摘要保留在一页内，将幻灯片部分保留在三张幻灯片上；为不会询问作者条件含义的高管撰写文章，并省略系统点击和每个数据室文件的总目录。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf` — 一份 PDF，包含一页 IT 尽职调查摘要以及集成条件，以及为投资委员会提供的三张演示风格幻灯片。 （摘要必须恰好占据一页。；演示部分必须恰好包含三张幻灯片或三个清晰分开的幻灯片页。；建议必须是单一的、明确的，并且在摘要和幻灯片中保持一致。；文件必须区分证据、假设、未知因素、条件、所有者、时间安排和升级。；文件必须在使用术语操作之前定义第1日。；文件不得发明不受支持的交易、财务、许可、安全或操作事实。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: PDF 文字提取；可打开原文件查看排版。
gold.text:
IT DILIGENCE DECISION SUMMARY

Cranmere Surveying acquisition
                                                                                               Prepared by Wilhelmina Arriaga for Hester Kilbride



DECISION REQUESTED

PROCEED ONLY SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS
The unresolved right to continue using the critical survey-processing capability after a change of control is material to
continuity and must be closed or escalated before completion.



  EVIDENCE BASIS AND LIMITS

  Evidence reviewed: an unorganised data room of roughly 600 files, including licence registers, a vendor technology-diligence
  report, contractor invoices and Cranmere's risk log. No complete buyer-validated inventory or agreed buyer view was supplied. The
  invoice annex is a diligence lead, not proof of a contractual outcome.



WORKING DEFINITIONS

Day 1 means the first operational day after legal completion; it is not legal completion itself. Day 1 controls preserve service
while ownership changes. The end-state technology model is the later, governed operating model once dependencies are
resolved.

criteria.description: 名为 stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf 的 PDF 存在且可读。
criteria.evidence: 已提交工作目录文件并成功提取 PDF 文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的文件名、PDF 有效性以及文本是否可选择或可检查。

original.criterion: A PDF named stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf is present and readable.
original.evidence: Submitted working-directory file and successful PDF text extraction.
original.grader_hint: Check exact filename, PDF validity, and that text is selectable or otherwise inspectable.

criteria.description: 该 PDF 恰好包含四页：一页摘要页和三页幻灯片。
criteria.evidence: PDF 页数和渲染页面审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算页数并验证第一页是摘要，第二页到第四页是幻灯片式页面。

original.criterion: The PDF contains exactly four pages: one summary page and three slide pages.
original.evidence: PDF page count and rendered page review.
original.grader_hint: Count pages and verify that page one is the summary and pages two through four are slide-style pages.

criteria.description: 第一页可用作单页执行 IT 尽职调查摘要，而不是幻灯片的延续。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断委员会成员是否可以在不看幻灯片的情况下阅读第一页作为独立的摘要。

original.criterion: The first page is usable as a one-page executive IT diligence summary rather than a continuation of the slides.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a committee member can read page one as a self-contained summary without turning to the slides.

criteria.description: 该工件准确地提出了一项明确的交易建议。
criteria.evidence: 第一页和幻灯片上的推荐语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受其中一项继续、有条件地继续或不继续；拒绝竞争或未解决的替代方案。

original.criterion: The artifact makes exactly one clear transaction recommendation.
original.evidence: Recommendation language on page one and slides.
original.grader_hint: Accept one of proceed, proceed subject to conditions, or do not proceed; reject competing or unresolved alternatives.

criteria.description: 摘要和所有相关幻灯片都一致地阐述了相同的建议。
criteria.grader_hint: 结论及其限定在章节之间不得改变。

original.criterion: The same recommendation is stated consistently in the summary and all relevant slides.
original.grader_hint: The conclusion and its qualification must not change between sections.

criteria.description: 该文件定义了1日，然后将其用作运营里程碑。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受法定完成和完成后第一个运营日之间的明确区别，并在运营要求之前说明所选含义。

original.criterion: The document defines Day 1 before using it as an operational milestone.
original.grader_hint: Accept an explicit distinction between legal completion and the first operating day after completion, with the chosen meaning stated before operational requirements.

criteria.description: 该文件将临时过渡控制与最终状态技术运营模式区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求对必须暂时起作用的内容以及集成后应存在的架构、所有权或流程进行单独处理。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes interim transition controls from the end-state technology operating model.
original.grader_hint: Look for separate treatment of what must work temporarily and what architecture, ownership, or process should exist after integration.

criteria.description: 调查处理软件许可证的控制权变更或同意风险被确定为与决策相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 许可证必须被描述为可能不可转让或依赖于控制权变更的同意，而不仅仅是普通的许可证库存问题。

original.criterion: The change-of-control or consent risk for the survey-processing software licence is identified as decision-relevant.
original.grader_hint: The licence must be described as potentially unassignable or consent-dependent on change of control, not merely as an ordinary licence inventory issue.

criteria.description: 许可风险与业务连续性或交易完成后果有关。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找丢失或缺少软件的运营后果以及为什么会影响投资决策。

original.criterion: The licence risk is connected to business continuity or transaction completion consequences.
original.grader_hint: Look for the operational consequence of losing or lacking the software and why that affects the investment decision.

criteria.description: 该文件要求在相关交易或运营里程碑之前确认许可证的转让、同意、续签或更换位置。
criteria.grader_hint: 模糊地建议审查合同是不够的；该条件必须涉及控制权变更后继续使用该软件的权利。

original.criterion: The document requires confirmation of the licence's assignment, consent, renewal, or replacement position before the relevant transaction or operating milestone.
original.grader_hint: A vague recommendation to review contracts is insufficient; the condition must address the right to continue using the software after control changes.

criteria.description: 当证据支持该优先级时，许可证问题的优先级高于与决策不太相关的描述性发现。
criteria.evidence: 风险排名、决策理由和视觉重点。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断该工件是否表明了为什么一个不太清晰但对交易至关重要的问题值得委员会关注。

original.criterion: The licence issue is prioritised above less decision-relevant descriptive findings when the evidence supports that prioritisation.
original.evidence: Risk ranking, decision rationale, and visual emphasis.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the artifact shows why a less legible but transaction-critical issue deserves committee attention.

criteria.description: 每项材料发现都表明或明确暗示了一种影响，而不仅仅是一种观察。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受与调查结果相关的连续性、法律执行、网络暴露、成本、集成延迟或声誉风险等影响。

original.criterion: Each material finding states or clearly implies an impact, not merely an observation.
original.grader_hint: Accept impacts such as continuity, legal execution, cyber exposure, cost, integration delay, or reputational risk when tied to a finding.

criteria.description: 使用可辩护的业务决策基础对重大发现进行优先排序。
criteria.evidence: 风险排名或优先顺序的理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对严重性、时间安排、可逆性、依赖性或决策影响的明确或容易推断的考虑。

original.criterion: Material findings are prioritised using a defensible business-decision basis.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit or readily inferable consideration of severity, timing, reversibility, dependency, or decision impact.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了验证软件和技术所有权或权利记录的需要。
criteria.grader_hint: 处理不应只是说存在登记册，并解决记录是否支持合法的持续使用。

original.criterion: The document identifies the need to validate software and technology ownership or entitlement records.
original.grader_hint: The treatment should go beyond saying that a register exists and address whether records support lawful continued use.

criteria.description: 该文件将第三方或承包商依赖性视为相关的集成风险。
criteria.grader_hint: 承认访问、知识集中、连续性或合同依赖性，而不仅仅是提及发票。

original.criterion: The document addresses third-party or contractor dependency as an integration risk where relevant.
original.grader_hint: Acknowledge access, knowledge concentration, continuity, or contractual dependency rather than merely mentioning invoices.

criteria.description: 该文件将网络或信息安全暴露作为尽职调查的一个维度。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受对控制、事件、特权访问、弹性或证据差距的适当处理。

original.criterion: The document addresses cyber or information-security exposure as a diligence dimension.
original.grader_hint: Accept a proportionate treatment of controls, incidents, privileged access, resilience, or evidence gaps.

criteria.description: 在没有证据的情况下，安全问题不会作为事件或违规的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件可以识别暴露或证据差距，但必须将其与已确认的妥协区分开来。

original.criterion: Security concerns are not presented as proof of an incident or breach without evidence.
original.grader_hint: The document may identify exposure or an evidence gap, but must distinguish that from confirmed compromise.

criteria.description: 该文档将访问和身份管理视为转换控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找加入者、离开者、特权访问、共享帐户或同等控制范围。

original.criterion: The document treats access and identity management as a transition control.
original.grader_hint: Look for joiner, leaver, privileged access, shared accounts, or equivalent control coverage.

criteria.description: 该文件涉及关键测量服务的备份、恢复或操作弹性。
criteria.evidence: 连续性查找或积分条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 该工件应该需要证据或临时控制，而不仅仅是说弹性很重要。

original.criterion: The document addresses backup, recovery, or operational resilience for critical surveying services.
original.grader_hint: The artifact should require evidence or an interim control, not simply say resilience is important.

criteria.description: 转换控制包括一种识别和保护关键业务应用程序和数据的方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受应用程序/数据关键性清单、服务所有权、受保护的迁移范围或同等内容。

original.criterion: Transition controls include a way to identify and protect business-critical applications and data.
original.grader_hint: Accept an application/data criticality inventory, service ownership, protected migration scope, or equivalent.

criteria.description: 该文档将数据迁移、访问或保留作为一个独特的集成问题来解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找数据所有权、完整性、访问连续性、保留或迁移验证。

original.criterion: The document addresses data migration, access, or retention as a distinct integration concern.
original.grader_hint: Look for data ownership, integrity, access continuity, retention, or migration validation.

criteria.description: 拟议的过渡方法在所有权和系统发生变化时保持服务连续性。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断该计划是否认识到系统不能在完成后简单地关闭。

original.criterion: The proposed transition approach preserves service continuity while ownership and systems are changing.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the plan recognises that systems cannot simply be switched off at completion.

criteria.description: 该工件将负责的所有者或负责的功能分配给许可证解析条件。
criteria.evidence: 状况登记册或责任标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受指定的角色或职能，例如法律、技术、交易线索或供应商管理；无主的行动不能满足。

original.criterion: The artifact assigns an accountable owner or accountable function to the licence-resolution condition.
original.grader_hint: Accept named role or function such as legal, technology, deal lead, or vendor management; an ownerless action does not satisfy.

criteria.description: 物质条件的时间与有意义的里程碑相关，例如签署、完成、1 日或关闭后整合。
criteria.grader_hint: 时间安排必须区分决策前、完成前、过渡和最终状态需求（如果适用）。

original.criterion: Material conditions have timing tied to a meaningful milestone such as signing, completion, Day 1, or post-close integration.
original.grader_hint: Timing must distinguish pre-decision, pre-completion, transition, and end-state needs where applicable.

criteria.description: 该文件说明了哪些证据或决策门将关闭许可条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受书面同意、可转让性确认、更换计划或经过明确测试的委员会批准的书面替代方案。

original.criterion: The document states what evidence or decision gate would close the licence condition.
original.grader_hint: Accept written consent, assignability confirmation, replacement plan, or a documented committee-approved alternative with an explicit test.

criteria.description: 该工件识别未解决的物质状况的升级或决策权限。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找谁决定是否暂停、调整、重新谈判、更换或接受残余风险。

original.criterion: The artifact identifies escalation or decision authority for an unresolved material condition.
original.grader_hint: Look for who decides whether to pause, condition, renegotiate, replace, or accept residual risk.

criteria.description: 该文件将继续进行的条件与关闭后改进积压工作区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 最重要的阻碍因素绝不能被淹没在随意的增强措施中。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes a condition to proceed from a post-close improvement backlog.
original.grader_hint: The most consequential blockers must not be buried among discretionary enhancements.

criteria.description: 该文件确定了目标国家技术所有权或治理模型。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受负责任的服务所有权、架构治理、供应商管理或同等的运营模型清晰度。

original.criterion: The document identifies a target-state technology ownership or governance model.
original.grader_hint: Accept accountable service ownership, architecture governance, vendor management, or equivalent operating-model clarity.

criteria.description: 在转换依赖性仍然存在的情况下，目标状态不会立即呈现为可实现的。
criteria.evidence: 过渡语言与目标状态语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文档应该对目标状态进行排序或限定，而不是将其折叠成 Day 1 承诺。

original.criterion: The target state is not presented as achievable immediately where transition dependencies remain.
original.grader_hint: The document should sequence or qualify the target state rather than collapse it into a Day 1 promise.

criteria.description: 摘要说明了尽职证据的范围和局限性。
criteria.grader_hint: 它应该承认数据室无组织，并且缺乏经过买方验证的完整库存或同等限制。

original.criterion: The summary states the scope and limitations of the diligence evidence.
original.grader_hint: It should acknowledge the unorganised data room and absence of a complete buyer-validated inventory or equivalent limitation.

criteria.description: 该文件将已确认的证据、管理层的断言、假设和未解决的未知因素分开。
criteria.evidence: 整个工件的标签或严格的措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断委员会读者是否可以区分已知的内容和推断的内容或仍需要验证的内容。

original.criterion: The document separates confirmed evidence, management assertion, assumption, and unresolved unknown.
original.evidence: Labels or disciplined wording throughout the artifact.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a committee reader can tell what is known versus inferred or still requiring validation.

criteria.description: 该文档标识了许可证问题的来源类型或证据线索，但没有声称所提供的文件已得到充分审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 它可以引用发票附件或合同证据作为尽职调查线索，同时准确地标记验证的需要。

original.criterion: The document identifies the source type or evidence trail for the licence concern without claiming a supplied file was fully reviewed.
original.grader_hint: It may refer to an invoice annex or contract evidence as a diligence lead, while accurately flagging the need for validation.

criteria.description: 没有发明任何不受支持的购买价格、储蓄、人数、概率、事件计数、许可费或其他精确的交易数据。
criteria.evidence: PDF 中的所有数字声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 可以使用已知的上下文数量，例如大约 600 文件和 4 9 月会议；不得捏造不受支持的交易指标。

original.criterion: No unsupported purchase price, savings, headcount, probability, incident count, licence fee, or other precise transaction figure is invented.
original.evidence: All numeric claims in the PDF.
original.grader_hint: Known contextual quantities such as roughly 600 files and the 4 September meeting may be used; unsupported deal metrics must not be fabricated.

criteria.description: 任何定量陈述要么源自所述背景，明确标记为假设，要么定性表达。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果虚构的估计被作为勤勉事实呈现，则不予奖励。

original.criterion: Any quantitative statement is either sourced to the stated context, clearly labelled as an assumption, or expressed qualitatively.
original.evidence: Numbers and labels in the artifact.
original.grader_hint: Do not award if invented estimates are presented as diligence facts.

criteria.description: 该建议解释了为什么许可证问题和其他优先风险导致了所选择的决定。
criteria.grader_hint: 结论必须是推理出来的，而不仅仅是断言。

original.criterion: The recommendation explains why the licence issue and other priority risks lead to the selected decision.
original.grader_hint: The conclusion must be reasoned, not merely asserted.

criteria.description: 该建议与不确定性相称，并且不会毫无理由地将未解决的问题视为无害或被证明是致命的。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断所选的姿势是否适当地使用了条件、升级或残余风险接受。

original.criterion: The recommendation is proportionate to uncertainty and does not treat an unresolved issue as either harmless or proven fatal without rationale.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the selected posture appropriately uses conditions, escalation, or residual-risk acceptance.

criteria.description: 这三张幻灯片以连贯的顺序涵盖了决策、优先风险和条件以及过渡/最终状态的影响。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些幻灯片应作为紧凑的委员会叙述，而不是三个不相关的页面。

original.criterion: The three slides cover decision, priority risks and conditions, and transition/end-state implications in a coherent sequence.
original.grader_hint: The slides should function as a compact committee narrative rather than three unrelated pages.

criteria.description: 该工件可供高管使用：可以快速找到关键决策、重大风险、状况、所有者和时间安排。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 PDF 和内容导航。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断层次结构、压缩性、易读性，以及跨职能读者是否可以在不要求作者翻译的情况下进行操作。

original.criterion: The artifact is executive-usable: key decision, material risk, condition, owner, and timing can be found quickly.
original.evidence: Rendered PDF and navigation of content.
original.grader_hint: Judge hierarchy, compression, legibility, and whether a cross-functional reader can act without asking the author to translate it.

criteria.description: 该摘要不会成为所有尽职调查文件的目录或一般技术清单。
criteria.grader_hint: 它应该选择与决策相关的事项并解释其影响。

original.criterion: The summary does not become a catalogue of all diligence files or a general technology inventory.
original.grader_hint: It should select decision-relevant matters and explain their implications.

criteria.description: 该工件包括对关键调查处理能力的明确过渡期控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受连续性保证、批准的临时使用、受控访问、后备能力或等效的具体保障措施。

original.criterion: The artifact includes an explicit transition-period control for the critical survey-processing capability.
original.grader_hint: Accept continuity assurance, approved temporary use, controlled access, fallback capability, or an equivalent concrete safeguard.

criteria.description: 该工件在许可规则旁边声明了非断言或限制，明确指出识别控制权变更触发器本身并不证明终止。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找合同触发因素、实际终止以及法律或供应商确认的需要之间的区别。

original.criterion: The artifact states a non-assertion or limitation alongside the licence rule, making clear that identifying a change-of-control trigger does not itself prove termination.
original.grader_hint: Look for a distinction between a contractual trigger, an actual termination, and the need for legal or vendor confirmation.

criteria.description: 该工件声明了非断言或限制以及安全问题，明确指出已识别的控制差距本身并不证明存在违规行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须避免将证据差距或弱点转化为不受支持的事件主张。

original.criterion: The artifact states a non-assertion or limitation alongside security concerns, making clear that an identified control gap does not itself prove a breach.
original.grader_hint: The document must avoid converting an evidence gap or weakness into an unsupported incident claim.

criteria.description: 该工件声明了连续性计划的非断言或限制，明确表示后备计划并不能证明恢复能力已经过测试。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确的资格，记录或建议的恢复并不是测试成功的证据。

original.criterion: The artifact states a non-assertion or limitation alongside continuity planning, making clear that a fallback plan does not prove recovery capability has been tested.
original.grader_hint: Accept explicit qualification that documented or proposed recovery is not evidence of successful testing.

criteria.description: 该文件以单一决定结束，并没有以不优先的后续步骤列表结束。
criteria.evidence: 最终句子或最终视觉元素。
criteria.grader_hint: 决定中可能包含条件，但结局必须解决建议而不是推迟建议。

original.criterion: The document ends on the single decision and does not close with an unprioritised next-steps list.
original.evidence: Final sentence or final visual element.
original.grader_hint: Conditions may be embedded in the decision, but the ending must resolve the recommendation rather than defer it.

criteria.description: 该文档保持在所要求的物理限制内，同时保留可读的文本和可用的幻灯片演示。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 PDF 尺寸和目视检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果一页摘要溢出、幻灯片超过三张或压缩导致材料几乎无法阅读，则不要奖励。

original.criterion: The document remains within the requested physical limits while retaining readable text and usable slide presentation.
original.evidence: Rendered PDF dimensions and visual inspection.
original.grader_hint: Do not award if the one-page summary spills over, if there are more than three slides, or if compression makes the material practically unreadable.

spec.professional_context: This is an enterprise IT diligence and integration decision for a professional-services transaction, where software rights, operational continuity, cyber exposure, and separation of ownership can affect the investment decision. The artifact is intended for cross-functional executives who need a defensible decision and executable conditions rather than a catalogue of diligence observations.
difficulty_sources: materially incomplete diligence context with no supplied reference files
a buried change-of-control software-licence risk that must be distinguished from more visible but less decision-relevant findings
a transition state that must be addressed without confusing interim controls with the target operating model
the term "Day 1" has two plausible meanings for cross-functional stakeholders and must be defined before use
the memorandum must make one defensible investment-committee recommendation without inventing transaction facts or financial values
the document must fit a one-page summary and three-slide presentation format in a single file

authoring_plan.purpose: Create a compact doctrinal IT diligence decision artifact for the named acquisition scenario. The gold should reward disciplined claims, explicit non-claims, and a defensible conditional decision without requiring invented transaction facts.

gold_construction.format: Build one PDF with page one as a self-contained executive summary and pages two through four as exactly three slides. Use synthetic but clearly labelled assumptions only where needed to illustrate decision logic; do not introduce unsupported numeric deal facts.
gold_construction.core_decision: The reference solution should normally recommend proceeding subject to explicit conditions, with the survey-processing licence treated as a gating or escalated condition because continued lawful use after change of control is unresolved. A different recommendation may pass if it is singular, proportionate, and defensibly tied to the uncertainty.

required_doctrinal_pairings.rule: A change-of-control clause or assignment restriction can make continued use of a critical software capability uncertain and therefore requires confirmation, consent, replacement, or an explicitly approved risk decision.
required_doctrinal_pairings.must_not_claim: The presence of a trigger proves that the licence has already terminated or that the transaction is legally blocked.

required_doctrinal_pairings.rule: An access or security control gap should receive a proportionate transition control and validation owner.
required_doctrinal_pairings.must_not_claim: A control gap by itself proves a security incident or breach.

required_doctrinal_pairings.rule: A continuity or recovery requirement should be tested or evidenced before it is relied upon.
required_doctrinal_pairings.must_not_claim: A written fallback plan proves that recovery capability works.

required_doctrinal_pairings.rule: A Day 1 control is an interim operating safeguard, not automatically the target-state architecture.
required_doctrinal_pairings.must_not_claim: The interim arrangement is the final integrated operating model.

professional_content_constraints: Include the critical survey-processing licence risk and its business-continuity consequence.
Include licence entitlement and ownership validation.
Include proportionate security and identity/access transition controls.
Include backup, recovery, or resilience validation for critical services.
Include contractor or third-party dependency considerations.
Separate evidence, assumptions, unknowns, conditions, owners, timing, and escalation.
State what evidence closes the licence condition.
Distinguish pre-decision or pre-completion gates from Day 1 controls and longer-term end-state work.
End on one recommendation rather than a deferred action list.
gold_construction.arbitrary_conventions: No private codes, invented sheet names, or exact answer values are required. The only required filename is supplied in the request. Use ordinary professional labels such as owner, timing, evidence, condition, assumption, unknown, and escalation.
gold_construction.review_method: Render the PDF and inspect page count, page-one fit, slide count, legibility, consistency of recommendation, first-use definition of Day 1, and the doctrinal rule/non-assertion pairings. Then evaluate each rubric item from the submitted artifact alone.

deliverables.description: A single PDF containing a one-page IT diligence summary with integration conditions and exactly three presentation-style slides for the investment committee.
constraints: The summary must occupy exactly one page.
The presentation portion must contain exactly three slides or three clearly separated slide pages.
The recommendation must be singular, explicit, and consistent across the summary and slides.
The document must distinguish evidence, assumptions, unknowns, conditions, owners, timing, and escalation.
The document must define Day 1 before using the term operationally.
The document must not invent unsupported transaction, financial, licensing, security, or operational facts.

title_original: authored doc it diligence change of control 001
original_instruction:
You are Wilhelmina Arriaga, the technology diligence lead supporting Hester Kilbride on Stellwyn Advisory Group's investment committee review of its proposed acquisition of Cranmere Surveying. Greyhaven Freight and Pembroke Council are also involved in the wider portfolio discussion, so keep the named transaction and the audience unambiguous. The data room contains roughly 600 unorganised files, including licence registers, a vendor technology-diligence report, three years of contractor invoices, and Cranmere's risk log, but there is no supplied index or agreed buyer view. One easily missed invoice annex appears to concern an unassignable survey-processing licence that may terminate or require consent on a change of control; the committee is more likely to notice the larger, cleaner findings that may not change its vote. Viktor Delacroix, Noor Dalgaard, Idris Wolstenholme, and Felix Escamilla will use the material alongside finance, legal, operations, security, and the deal team. Prepare one PDF named `stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf` and place it at the top level of the working directory. It must contain a one-page IT diligence summary with integration conditions followed by exactly three presentation-style slides for the 4 September investment committee. Make one clear recommendation on whether to proceed, proceed only subject to conditions, or not proceed, and make the recommendation the ending decision rather than a list of future steps. Define the term “Day 1” before relying on it, because some readers use it for legal completion and others for the first operational day after completion; distinguish that transition state from the end-state technology model. Do not pretend that the data room proves facts it does not prove, do not invent purchase price, savings, incident, licence, headcount, or probability figures, and label assumptions, unknowns, dependencies, owners, timing, and escalation points plainly. Keep the summary to one page and the deck portion to three slides; write for executives who will not ask the author what a condition means, and leave out system click-throughs and a general catalogue of every data-room file.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `stellwyn_cranmere_it_diligence_committee.pdf` — A single PDF containing a one-page IT diligence summary with integration conditions and exactly three presentation-style slides for the investment committee. (The summary must occupy exactly one page.; The presentation portion must contain exactly three slides or three clearly separated slide pages.; The recommendation must be singular, explicit, and consistent across the summary and slides.; The document must distinguish evidence, assumptions, unknowns, conditions, owners, timing, and escalation.; The document must define Day 1 before using the term operationally.; The document must not invent unsupported transaction, financial, licensing, security, or operational facts.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
